model: NFS-Ganesha userspace NFSv3/NFSv4 server, FSAL_VFS, with rpcbind on Debian 12

capture.command: Privileged container with an ext4 Docker volume at /export; apt-get install rpcbind nfs-ganesha nfs-ganesha-vfs netbase; ganesha.conf: NFS_CORE_PARAM { Protocols = 3, 4; MNT_Port = 20048; }, EXPORT 10 /export/projects (Access_Type = None, CLIENT { Clients = 192.168.112.0/20, lab-app02; Access_Type = RW; }), EXPORT 20 /export/scratch (Access_Type = RO, no client list); rpcbind -w; ganesha.nfsd -f /etc/ganesha/ganesha.conf. The real nas collector binary (options mode=nfs, portmapPort) called rpcbind GETPORT and MOUNT v3 EXPORT against 127.0.0.1 published ports through a TCP recording proxy that wrote each direction of each connection verbatim. lab-app02 does not resolve in the lab, which Ganesha reports as the group string <unknown>.

files.name: rpcbind-getport.request.bin
files.description: Record-marked ONC RPC call bytes the collector sent to rpcbind (PMAPPROC_GETPORT 100005 v3 tcp)

files.name: mount-export.request.bin
files.description: Record-marked MOUNTPROC3_EXPORT call bytes the collector sent
